<!-- Project Embed Viewer Modal -->
<div class="project-viewer-overlay" id="projectViewer">
  <div class="project-viewer-modal">
    <div class="project-viewer-header">
      <div class="project-viewer-title" id="viewerTitle">Project</div>
      <button class="viewer-close-btn" onclick="closeViewer()" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div class="project-viewer-body">
      <div class="viewer-loading" id="viewerLoading">
        <div class="spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading project...</p>
      </div>
      <iframe id="projectFrame" title="Project viewer" onload="hideLoading()"></iframe>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>


<script>
function openViewer(id, title, src) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('projectViewer');
  const frame   = document.getElementById('projectFrame');
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('viewerTitle');
  const loading = document.getElementById('viewerLoading');

  titleEl.textContent = title;
  frame.src = '';
  loading.style.display = 'flex';
  frame.style.opacity = '0';

  overlay.classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

  setTimeout(() => { frame.src = src; }, 80);
}

function hideLoading() {
  const loading = document.getElementById('viewerLoading');
  const frame   = document.getElementById('projectFrame');
  loading.style.display = 'none';
  frame.style.opacity = '1';
  frame.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
}

function closeViewer() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('projectViewer');
  const frame   = document.getElementById('projectFrame');
  overlay.classList.remove('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
  frame.src = '';
}

function openExternal(url) {
  window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
}

document.getElementById('projectViewer').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeViewer();
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeViewer();
});
</script>
